name: ERP Transaction Validation
description: Decide whether an ERP document (journal entry, purchase order / goods receipt / invoice set, stock movement or payroll run) is valid under a compact, stated rulebook. ERP posting engines enforce these controls mechanically; a model that eyeballs documents instead of checking each rule (balance, open period, three-way match, master data, limits) lets bad postings through or blocks good ones.
system_prompt:
You validate ERP documents against the rulebook below. Check every rule that the input gives enough data to test; rules for which the input provides no data are treated as satisfied. The document is invalid if ANY applicable rule is violated.
RULEBOOK
1. Double entry: total debits must equal total credits.
2. Posting period: the posting date's period must be OPEN.
3. Three-way match: PO, goods receipt (GR) and invoice must all exist; GR quantity and invoice quantity must equal the PO quantity unless a quantity tolerance is stated, and invoice unit price / value must be within the stated tolerance of the PO. A missing GR makes the match fail.
4. Cost centre: must be active and belong to the posting company code.
5. Inventory: a goods issue cannot exceed on-hand stock (issuing exactly the on-hand quantity is allowed).
6. Payroll: gross = sum of the earnings components; net = gross minus ALL deductions.
7. Approval limits: the approver's role limit applies to the total document value (not per line); a document above the approver's limit is invalid unless approved by a higher role.
8. Currency: document currency must equal the company-code currency unless an FX rate is given, in which case the converted amount is used.
9. Tax code: must exist in the tax code list given in the input.
decision must be "valid" or "invalid".
Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"decision": <value>, "confidence": <0..1>, "reason": "<one sentence>"}

decision.instructions: Is this ERP document valid under the rulebook? Check every rule the input gives data to test; rules with no data are satisfied. Invalid if ANY applicable rule is violated. Recompute every stated total yourself; a stated figure that differs from the computed one violates its rule. 1 Double entry: total debits = total credits. 2 Posting period of the posting date must be OPEN. 3 Three-way match: PO, goods receipt (GR) and invoice must all exist (missing GR fails); GR and invoice qty must equal PO qty unless a qty tolerance is stated; invoice unit price/value within stated tolerance of PO. 4 Cost centre active and belongs to the posting company code. 5 Goods issue cannot exceed on-hand stock (issuing exactly on-hand is allowed). 6 Payroll: gross = sum of earnings components; net = gross minus ALL deductions. 7 Approver role limit applies to total document value (not per line); above limit is invalid unless approved by a higher role. 8 Document currency must equal company-code currency unless an FX rate is given, then use the converted amount. 9 Tax code must exist in the tax code list given.

criteria.true: Valid: no applicable rulebook rule is violated.
criteria.false: Invalid: at least one applicable rulebook rule is violated.

cases.title: Clean journal entry
cases.input:
MASTER DATA
Periods: 2026-08 = CLOSED, 2026-09 = OPEN.
Cost centres: CC-100 (company 1000, active), CC-200 (company 1000, INACTIVE), CC-300 (company 2000, active).
Company 1000: currency EUR. Company 2000: currency USD.
Tax codes: V0 (0%), V1 (10%), V2 (20%).

DOCUMENT: Journal entry, company 1000, posting date 2026-09-14, currency EUR.
Dr 6200 Travel expense  1,200.00  (CC-100, tax code V1 not applicable)
Dr 1400 Input VAT  240.00  (tax code V2)
Cr 2100 Accounts payable  1,440.00
cases.rationale: Debits 1,440.00 = credits 1,440.00, period 2026-09 is open, CC-100 is active in company 1000, tax code V2 exists, currency matches.

cases.title: Journal balance (templated credit)
cases.input:
MASTER DATA
Periods: 2026-08 = CLOSED, 2026-09 = OPEN.
Cost centres: CC-100 (company 1000, active), CC-200 (company 1000, INACTIVE), CC-300 (company 2000, active).
Company 1000: currency EUR. Company 2000: currency USD.
Tax codes: V0 (0%), V1 (10%), V2 (20%).

DOCUMENT: Journal entry, company 1000, posting date 2026-09-03, currency EUR.
Dr 6100 Rent expense  1,000.00  (CC-100)
Cr 2100 Accounts payable  {{c}}
cases.rationale: Valid only when the credit equals the 1,000.00 debit. 1,000.01 is a one-cent near-miss that must still fail rule 1.

cases.title: Balanced but period closed
cases.input:
MASTER DATA
Periods: 2026-08 = CLOSED, 2026-09 = OPEN.
Cost centres: CC-100 (company 1000, active), CC-200 (company 1000, INACTIVE), CC-300 (company 2000, active).
Company 1000: currency EUR. Company 2000: currency USD.
Tax codes: V0 (0%), V1 (10%), V2 (20%).

DOCUMENT: Journal entry, company 1000, posting date 2026-08-29, currency EUR.
Dr 6300 Bank charges  800.00  (CC-100)
Cr 1000 Bank account  800.00
The entry is perfectly balanced and was approved by the finance controller.
cases.rationale: The entry balances, but August 2026 is closed so rule 2 fails. Balance is the distractor.

cases.title: Invoice matches PO but no goods receipt
cases.input:
DOCUMENT SET (company 1000, EUR)
PO 4500123: 100 units of item A-77 at 12.50 = 1,250.00.
Goods receipts for PO 4500123: none posted to date.
Vendor invoice INV-8841: 100 units of A-77 at 12.50 = 1,250.00, dated 2026-09-10, posting date 2026-09-12 (period OPEN).
The invoice agrees with the PO exactly on quantity, price and value.
cases.rationale: Rule 3 needs all three documents; with no GR the three-way match fails even though invoice and PO agree.

cases.title: Invoice price vs PO tolerance (templated)
cases.input:
DOCUMENT SET (company 1000, EUR, period OPEN)
PO 4500200: 50 units at unit price 100.00 = 5,000.00. Price tolerance: +/-2% of PO unit price. Quantity tolerance: none.
GR 5000111: 50 units received.
Invoice INV-9001: 50 units at unit price {{pr}}.00.
cases.rationale: 2% of 100.00 is 2.00, so unit prices from 98 to 102 inclusive pass; 97 and 103 and beyond fail. Boundaries are inclusive.

cases.title: Rounding difference within tolerance
cases.input:
DOCUMENT SET (company 1000, EUR, period OPEN)
Header rule for this vendor: value tolerance +/-0.5% of PO value; quantity tolerance none.
PO 4500310: 3 units at 33.33 = 99.99.
GR 5000140: 3 units received.
Invoice INV-7712: 3 units, vendor-rounded invoice total 100.00.
cases.rationale: The 0.01 difference is 0.01% of 99.99, far inside the 0.5% tolerance; quantities match and all three documents exist.

cases.title: Goods issue vs on-hand (templated)
cases.input:
DOCUMENT: Goods issue to production order PO-77, plant 1000, posting date 2026-09-08 (period OPEN).
Material M-200 issued quantity: {{q}} units.
Stock overview for M-200 at plant 1000: on-hand 120 units, of which 0 blocked.
cases.rationale: Issuing up to and including the on-hand 120 is allowed; 121 or more would drive stock negative.

cases.title: Cost centre active and in company (templated)
cases.input:
MASTER DATA
Periods: 2026-08 = CLOSED, 2026-09 = OPEN.
Cost centres: CC-100 (company 1000, active), CC-200 (company 1000, INACTIVE), CC-300 (company 2000, active).
Company 1000: currency EUR. Company 2000: currency USD.
Tax codes: V0 (0%), V1 (10%), V2 (20%).

DOCUMENT: Journal entry, company 1000, posting date 2026-09-20, currency EUR.
Dr 6500 Training expense  750.00  (cost centre {{cc}})
Cr 2100 Accounts payable  750.00
The entry balances and the period is open.
cases.rationale: Only CC-100 is both active and in company 1000. CC-200 is inactive; CC-300 is active but belongs to company 2000.

cases.title: Payroll net omits a deduction
cases.input:
DOCUMENT: Payroll run, employee E-4410, company 1000, period 2026-09 (OPEN).
Earnings: basic 4,000.00; overtime 350.00; housing allowance 200.00. Stated gross: 4,550.00.
Deductions: income tax 800.00; pension 200.00; health insurance 150.00.
Stated net pay: 3,550.00.
cases.rationale: Gross 4,550 is correct but net must be 4,550 - 1,150 = 3,400. 3,550 omits the health insurance deduction (rule 6).

cases.title: PO approved above role limit by splitting lines
cases.input:
DOCUMENT: Purchase order 4500420, company 1000, EUR.
Lines: 3 lines of 2,400.00 each (total 7,200.00).
Approved by: J. Lee, role Buyer.
Approval limits by role: Buyer up to 5,000.00; Purchasing Manager up to 25,000.00; CFO unlimited.
cases.rationale: The limit applies to the total document value of 7,200.00, not per line, so a Buyer cannot approve it (rule 7).

cases.title: Foreign-currency invoice with FX rate given
cases.input:
MASTER DATA
Periods: 2026-08 = CLOSED, 2026-09 = OPEN.
Cost centres: CC-100 (company 1000, active), CC-200 (company 1000, INACTIVE), CC-300 (company 2000, active).
Company 1000: currency EUR. Company 2000: currency USD.
Tax codes: V0 (0%), V1 (10%), V2 (20%).

DOCUMENT: Vendor invoice posted in company 1000 (EUR), posting date 2026-09-15, CC-100.
Invoice currency USD, amount 10,000.00. FX rate USD->EUR on posting date: 0.92 (given on the document).
Posting: Dr 6400 Software expense 9,200.00 EUR; Cr 2100 Accounts payable 9,200.00 EUR.
cases.rationale: Currency differs from the company currency but an FX rate is supplied; 10,000 x 0.92 = 9,200 and the entry balances in EUR (rule 8).

cases.title: Unknown tax code
cases.input:
MASTER DATA
Periods: 2026-08 = CLOSED, 2026-09 = OPEN.
Cost centres: CC-100 (company 1000, active), CC-200 (company 1000, INACTIVE), CC-300 (company 2000, active).
Company 1000: currency EUR. Company 2000: currency USD.
Tax codes: V0 (0%), V1 (10%), V2 (20%).

DOCUMENT: Journal entry, company 1000, posting date 2026-09-18, currency EUR.
Dr 6600 Consulting expense 500.00 (CC-100)
Dr 1400 Input VAT 50.00 (tax code V5)
Cr 2100 Accounts payable 550.00
cases.rationale: Debits equal credits and master data is fine, but tax code V5 is not in the list V0/V1/V2 (rule 9).
